breakdown.description: The prompt forms the strain energy with a constant peak moment, even though the cantilever bending moment under an end load varies along the span.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly followed the incorrect instruction to use a constant peak moment M = P*L over the full span, producing delta = P*L³/(EI) = 3.375 mm. The ground truth removes this erroneous instruction entirely, expecting the correct varying moment M(x) = P*(L-x) to be used, which yields the correct result of P*L³/(3EI) = 1.125 mm. The agent even acknowledged the error in a note but still applied the wrong approach, failing to align with the ground truth.
